name: palette-authoring
description: Focused agent scenarios for choosing palette generator controls without inventing author intent.

prompts.prompt: Create a palette from our brand blue #1682d5. That exact blue must not change.
Generate a blue palette, but keep #1682d5 within a perceptual distance of 2.
Use #ff4db8 as inspiration for the pink family, but it can move if that makes the ramp more balanced.
Keep the same palette families but make the overall result more muted.
Create blue, green, and orange palette families.

expectedDecision.question: Should this remain one theme accent color, or become a light and dark accent ramp?

prompts.prompt: Generate a full light and dark accent ramp from #ff4db8.
Add an illustration color at stop 12.5 to the blue family.
Create a specialized five-stop palette for data visualization.
